excluded_observation.reason: Sandbox user-systemd-bus unavailable; no host PID FD observation, not evidence of stopped service

conclusions.observed: FD increased with API actor reservations 24->31, while FD/actor stayed approximately 21; sockets dominate, SQLite decreased 6->3.
conclusions.inference: Growth is compatible with increased concurrency and per-episode Docker URL pools, rather than requiring an unbounded leak explanation.
conclusions.not_proven: Two ramp-up points do not prove long-run absence of leaks or quantify residual FD after draining tasks; SQLite is not established as the sole cause of previous EMFILE.
conclusions.capacity_illustration: Roughly 21 FD per actor at 48 actors already approaches the former 1024 limit, before variation and other work; this is an illustration, not a measured 48-actor maximum.
